module: Declares, if they do not exist, the ShaderData "AL_ShadowVisualizeShader" (dbgShadowVisualizeP.hlsl) and the CustomMaterial "AL_ShadowVisualizeMaterial" that displays a light's shadow map (sampler shadowMap = #AL_ShadowVizTexture). The rest of the file, the TorqueScript toggle functions (toggleShadowViz, showShadowVizForLight, lockShadowViz…), is entirely commented out and therefore inactive. No exported function.
